```python
from pocket_coffea.utils.configurator import Configurator
from pocket_coffea.lib.cut_definition import Cut
from pocket_coffea.lib.cut_functions import get_nObj_eq, get_nObj_min
from pocket_coffea.lib.categorization import MultiCut, CartesianSelection
from pocket_coffea.parameters.cuts import passthrough

localdir = "."

# Baseline selection applied before the cartesian split
baseline_cut = Cut(
    name="baseline",
    params={},
    function=lambda events, params, year, sample, **kwargs: (
        events.nJetGood >= 4
    ),
)

# Jet multiplicity binning: ==4, ==5, >=6 jets ("JetGood")
njet_multicut = MultiCut(
    name="Njet",
    cuts=[
        get_nObj_eq(4, coll="JetGood"),
        get_nObj_eq(5, coll="JetGood"),
        get_nObj_min(6, coll="JetGood"),
    ],
    cuts_names=["4j", "5j", "6j"],
)

# B-tag multiplicity binning: ==2, >=3 b-jets ("BJetGood")
nbjet_multicut = MultiCut(
    name="Nbjet",
    cuts=[
        get_nObj_eq(2, coll="BJetGood"),
        get_nObj_min(3, coll="BJetGood"),
    ],
    cuts_names=["2b", "3b"],
)

# Cross product of the two binnings -> 3 x 2 = 6 categories
cartesian_categories = CartesianSelection(
    multicuts=[njet_multicut, nbjet_multicut],
    common_cats=["baseline"],
)

cfg = Configurator(
    parameters=None,
    datasets={
        "jsons": [f"{localdir}/datasets/samples.json"],
        "filter": {
            "samples": [],
            "samples_exclude": [],
        },
    },
    workflow=None,
    skim=[passthrough],
    preselections=[baseline_cut],
    categories=cartesian_categories,
    weights={
        "common": {
            "inclusive": ["genWeight", "lumi", "XS"],
            "bycategory": {},
        },
    },
    variations={
        "weights": {"common": {"inclusive": [], "bycategory": {}}},
    },
    variables={},
)
```
